propositions: test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml each hand-copy identical gate+suite command sets, risking drift; consolidating into a single reusable workflow_call eliminates the duplication risk by construction

The monolithic build-and-test job in gerrit-verify.yaml must be replaced by a reusable-call that preserves the same gate coverage (lint, pip-audit, test matrix) while splitting the currently-inline lint/typecheck out of the 4x os×py matrix so they run once

test_ci_workflow_parity.py's five functions must be rewritten from copy-sync policing to single-source invariants, with three safety invariants (script asymmetry, pre-commit skips, redundant hook skips) preserved and retargeted at the new reusable

The reusable _build-and-test.yml must accept gerrit-refspec/gerrit-project/gerrit-url parameters for conditional checkout (branch-head when empty, Gerrit patchset when set), matching the _optionality.yml pattern, and take no secrets
test_workflow_names.py must be updated to cover _build-and-test.yml in its locked naming table

The vote job must continue listing 'build-and-test, optionality' in needs; the Verified vote must fold the reusable's job conclusions correctly, first proven post-merge via test.yml (branch-head lane) before the next Gerrit change lands
